paper.title_en: Higgs Mass and CP violating Phases Implications on the SUSY Breaking Scale in MSSM
paper.abstract_en: The large Higgs mass $m_h \approx 125 GeV$ can raise the values of the SUSY breaking parameters in the Minimal Supersymmetric Standard Model MSSM to the range of several TeV scale. The CP violating phases in the MSSM can induce EDMs of the fermions in the theory already in conflict with the current experimental upper limit unless the masses of the SUSY partners are on the heavy side. We invistigate the implications of both constraints, the Higgs Mass and the complete set of SUSY CP violating phases in the analysis of the electric dipole moments EDMs on the SUSY breaking parameters and thus on the SUSY mass spectrum. We use the electric dipole moments of the electron, the neutron and the proton as our probes in this study.
